title: Our logo is our most sacred asset.
slide_intent: Show how small alterations change a familiar mark. Comparing examples helps designers recognize which details must remain stable across reproductions.
strategic_value: Consistent use can preserve the lightning cut and silhouette that connect the Bolt name with its visual identity.
demonstration: A dark headline panel precedes eight disallowed alterations. Each example has a short caption and a red diagonal across the specimen.
practical_value: Review supplied artwork for rotation, gradient, depth, distortion, extraction or filling of the bolt, multiple colors and outlines.

content_islands.name: Section rail
content_islands.spec: Place the wordmark at the top of the dark rail, highlight the current topic in the navigation and set the small folio at the foot.

content_islands.name: Usage principle
content_islands.spec: Use a broad dark panel for the white statement and short follow-up copy.

content_islands.name: Alteration examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange eight light cards in two rows of four. Put one modified wordmark and its caption on each card, then overlay the red diagonal in the same direction throughout.
